name: make-a-letter
description: Create German letters from a template which follows DIN 5008 norms as local DOCX, ODT or exported PDF, RTF and text, or as a Google Doc.

interface.shortDescription: Letters in Word, ODT and PDF
interface.longDescription: Draft a German letter from notes and fill an optimized template with distinct sender, recipient, contact and signatory fields. Bundled Word and OpenDocument templates support local creation without Google Drive in hosts with file execution. PDF and RTF require an available converter or authorized Google Drive export; plain text is also supported. Google Docs uses a native copy of the template. Preserves the original template and checks missing fields, sample content and layout. Template-based formatting is not DIN certification.
defaultPrompt: Hilf mir, einen Brief mit der DIN-5008-Vorlage zu erstellen. Frage nach den noch fehlenden Angaben.
Formuliere aus meinen Stichpunkten einen sachlichen Brief und erstelle ihn als Google Doc mit der DIN-5008-Vorlage.
Übertrage meinen Briefentwurf in die DIN-5008-Vorlage und prüfe die Platzhalter und das Layout.
